description: This file contains the implementation of the function HALUTIL_GetModuleName, which extracts the module name from a given file path string. It processes strings to remove directory paths and isolate the module name.

methods.name: std::string HALUTIL_GetModuleName(const std::string & filePath)
methods.description: Extracts the module name from a file path by removing leading directory paths, leaving only the immediate parent directory name which is considered the module name.
